svg.title: Hermetiq Buildbarn deployment architecture
svg.desc: Buildbarn request, storage, worker control, node-local disk preparation, cache analytics, and VictoriaMetrics collection topology. A partition-ephemeral-disks DaemonSet prepares raw Local NVMe block devices for three storage shards serving CAS, AC, ISCC, and FSAC.
svg.text: Kubernetes request flow, three-shard storage, node-local disk preparation, operator-managed workers, cache analytics, and metrics

g.text: CR replaces the generic Workers box
Each shard serves CAS, AC, ISCC, and FSAC over :8981
Storage containers map host LVs into /dev/bb/{cas,ac,iscc,fsac}; no PVCs
1 privileged pod per SSD node · mounts host /dev
discovers Local NVMe devices and stripes them with LVM2
idempotent setup · ServiceAccount patches its Node label
CAS gets remaining capacity · AC 8Gi · ISCC 2Gi · FSAC 6Gi
storage pod remains Pending until all four LVs exist

svg.text: metrics endpoints · browser · frontend · scheduler · storage · worker
